title: First Bank Announces Third Quarter 2025 Earnings Conference Call
summary: HAMILTON, N.J., Oct. 01, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - First Bank (Nasdaq Global Market: FRBA) invites participation in a conference call to discuss the Company’s financial and operating performance during its third quarter ending on September 30, 2025. Event: Earnings Conference Call – Third Quarter 2025 When: Thursday, October 23, 2025 at 9:00 a.m. Eastern Time Access: Conference Call Dial-In: (800) 715-9871 (toll free) Conference Call Access Code: 6022332 Patrick L. Ryan, President and Chief Executive Officer, Andrew L. Hibshman, Chief Financial Officer, Peter J. Cahill, Chief Lending Officer, and Darleen Gillespie, Chief Retail Banking Officer will provide an overview of third quarter 2025 results. The management presentation typically lasts approximately fifteen to thirty minutes, followed by investor questions and discussion.
